lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce4Cu4Bi4Se12 (reduced formula CeCuBiSe3) is monoclinic with space group C2/c (No. 15) and 24 atoms in the unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi and Cu each adopt octahedral coordination by six Se atoms, while Ce is six-coordinate to Se. These polyhedra connect through corner- and edge-sharing between Bi and Cu octahedra, and corner-sharing among Ce and Bi octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
